Statement: 'Let B ⊆ R^3 be a material region (nonempty, bounded, open, [[def-cm-material-region-and-density]])'. No density, mass or integral clause of the supplier is used.

Statement hypothesis 'B ⊆ R^3 a material region' for the C1 motion of def-cm-continuum-motion. The supplier's nonempty-bounded-open clause is what makes B and psi_t(B) finite-measure Lebesgue domains: step 2.1 applies the change-of-variables theorem on B, step 4.1 applies differentiation under the integral over B, and step 1.1 uses compactness of the closure. No density or mass clause is used.
